[EN] I...I am not following you!
[ES] ¡Yo... yo no te sigo!

[EN] Th-th-the book! Where is it?
[ES] ¡El-el-el libro! ¿Dónde está?

[EN] See? I'm going to Seren's garden!
[ES] ¿Ves? ¡Me voy al jardín de Seren!

[EN] I'm on my way. You must take the book to him at all costs.
[ES] Voy en camino. Debes llevarle el libro a toda costa.
